description: CM Naidu unveils Venkatadri app by TTD to guide pilgrims with offline AI-powered facility maps and 350+ locations.
body_lead: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on Monday virtually launched ‘Venkatadri’, a mobile application developed by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) to help pilgrims locate essential facilities at Tirumala and access round-the-clock assistance. Powered by artificial intelligence, the app features a voice assistant to guide devotees to drinking-water points, darshan entry gates, medical centres, toilets, parking areas and food outlets. Its offline navigation facility enables pilgrims to access directions even in areas with poor or no internet connectivity.
